title: Small live runtime validation
checks: reference, resource, budget, and scope failures
time_split: Verifier-attempt time is separate from model initialization, hashing, and request latency. Estimated attempt cost is not wall-clock latency.
fresh_execution: Fresh inference need not reproduce every historical report. Retained reports are for deterministic parity only.
early_termination: Game mode has no early-termination experiment.
grouping: Snapshot related_group_id. Both candidates for a question stay in one group. Groups are not split across partitions.
excluded_records: Unresolved labels, skipped groups, and Development groups sharing History reference context are recorded exclusions. They are not eligible.
final_test_dataset: research_v1_final_test_v2_exploratory_v1 is a separate sealed dataset and is not this eligibility manifest.
dependencies: Person 2 adapter, hardware, prompt, and timing definitions
